entities.name: Podcast dataset
entities.description: A dataset used in Experiment 1, resulting in a graph with 8,564 nodes and 20,691 edges.

entities.name: News dataset
entities.description: A dataset used in Experiment 1, resulting in a graph with 15,754 nodes and 19,520 edges.

entities.name: Global approaches
entities.description: A category of GraphRAG methods that outperformed vector RAG in comprehensiveness and diversity.

entities.name: vector RAG (SS)
entities.description: Conventional vector-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation used as a baseline.

entities.name: GraphRAG approaches
entities.description: Methods utilizing graph structures for RAG, compared against source text summarization.

entities.name: source text summarization (TS)
entities.description: A baseline method involving summarization of source text, used for comparison with GraphRAG approaches.

entities.name: comprehensiveness
entities.description: A criterion used to evaluate the performance of RAG methods.

entities.name: diversity
entities.description: A criterion used to evaluate the performance of RAG methods.

entities.name: directness
entities.description: A validity test metric confirming that vector RAG produces the most direct responses.

entities.name: Empowerment
entities.description: A measure used to compare global approaches, vector RAG, and GraphRAG approaches.
